sarah: heads-up: onboarding Sunder13b-hybrid showing verb/object flips in QA when prompts contain diacritics.
matt: any diffs vs fp16 baseline?
sarah: fp16 clean. hybrid used quant-sieve v1.0 with per-head int3 for attention; exporter applied NFC tokenizer normalization and wrote `rotary_scale` as per-head float16 array. also exporter emitted a `vocab_map` but runtime loader ignores it.
lee: that sounds like two orthogonal transforms: vocab indices shifted + per-head rotary scales -> KV/cache and phase misalignment. did the exporter include `head_map`?
sarah: no head_map. runtime assumes canonical head ordering so packed heads were misinterpreted. embedding rows got remapped incorrectly.
matt: short-term mitigation: update loader to apply `vocab_map` on load if present and coerce `rotary_scale` to float32 broadcast. that should bring behavior near fp16.
buildbot: regression-alert: qa-suite verb-object-consistency decreased 8.4% for sunder13b-hybrid at 2025-01-17T12:03:45Z
sarah: opened PR with loader fallback + unit tests, will run a small sweep and report. tagging @lee for review.
